text: Write a Rust bare-metal UART driver and block-device abstraction for QEMU virt (PL011 at 0x09000000, virtio-mmio at 0x0a000000). Include read_blocks/write_blocks/capacity_blocks trait, layer-table magic check 0xAE86, expert_offset arithmetic, and boot-time halt on stride mismatch. Provide host-side unit tests for offset math and header validation.
